item.title: Calligraphy on Guitar
item.description: Music from the perspective of calligraphy: perform songs on the guitar as if writing them out in calligraphic style. First, employ triads and their inversions, use rests, maintain the emotional cadence, and play with a relaxed picking hand and a swift fretting hand.

item.title: Bridge and Water
item.description: Structure and form is one mode; free flow is another. Learn to inhabit both; sometimes building like a well-built bridge, other times moving like water flowing beneath it. The skill is knowing which mode serves the work.

item.title: DaVinci Resolve Workflow
item.description: I’m using an iPhone, a Blackmagic Camera app, and a Yeti microphone, all combined into a single ProRes file at 24fps with manual audio gain. I’ve tested and confirmed everything is clean in terms of frame rate, sync, and gain.

item.title: Guitar Recording Setup
item.description: My guitar recording philosophy has evolved toward minimal, purposeful gear: tone comes from the fingers, pick, guitar, and amp, while digital effects complement rather than replace the core sound.

item.title: Honne and Tatemae
item.description: Honne and tatemae aren’t simply truth versus lie. They’re both real, but at different levels. Tatemae is socially acceptable, while honne is the unfiltered truth that emerges when you trust someone. Neither is fake.

item.title: No Grand Plan, Just Steady State
item.description: I have thought about and diagnosed the mechanisms of weight gain and found that they are largely conditioned loops and the continuation of eating past satisfaction. I have made a simple and realistic plan that involves pre-portioning and gradual reduction of meal sizes.
